manual_review: Acceptance agent reviewed visible outputs; coordinating agent independently reviewed revised outputs and accepted.
transport: Actual Agent/Models SDK through previously user-authorized local worker key/proxy; Responses endpoint only.

boundaries.tools: Production RuntimeBridge._tools plus SDK write/subagent declarations; execution functions replaced by recording stubs.
boundaries.router: AST evaluates the actual production route_targets system assignment; model decision is real, service/store/admission is not exercised by those model cases.
boundaries.effects: No production message, file, delegation, approval, service, or database writes by this acceptance harness. Local transcripts/reports and disposable test schemas only.
boundaries.regressions: Separate real PostgreSQL tests use disposable schemas and offline-regression model, not provider calls.

initial_findings: Initial three natural positive social messages produced warm text but zero reaction tool calls. This evidence gap was preserved. Main social wording then explicitly named the reaction tool; two positives were selectively rerun.
privacy: Only visible text, tool intentions, numeric usage, source/prompt digests and review notes are retained here. Hidden thinking, signatures, encrypted provider content, and raw provider identifiers are omitted.

covers: Reaction changes do not create ReplyRequest or RoutingDecision rows.
Three-owner Duet branches share a six-acceptance causal-chain allowance; seventh route pauses until explicit continuation.

limitations: Single bounded observations establish examples, not deterministic behavior or a statistical success rate.
Final prompt was used for nine main cases and three router cases; distress and ordinary file task evidence came from the preceding prompt revision, whose relevant care/action rules were unchanged.
Stub success establishes model intent and post-tool response only; no live server reaction or real file action is claimed.
Online-unread presence detail was supplied to the model but not repeated to the other participant.
Sparse reaction-only Duet closure was accepted; the primary courtesy-loop gate is the production router.
